sessions.phase_label: SEO plan definition and trial-scope negotiation
Keyword research and on-page SEO planning
On-page implementation, backlink indexing, and evidence review

requirements.title: SEO Plan Deliverable
requirements.definition: Prepare a reviewable SEO plan limited to the client-requested services and excluding unwanted additional work.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the requested planning artifact only; execution of blogs, guest posts, on-page work, and off-page work remains in separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Guest Post Delivery
requirements.definition: Provide guest-posting work when included in the agreed SEO service scope.
requirements.boundary_note: Guest posting can be selected or excluded independently from blog writing, on-page optimization, and backlink creation.

requirements.title: Keyword Research Report
requirements.definition: Produce and revise the campaign keyword sheet, including the agreed keyword set and search-volume data.
requirements.boundary_note: Keyword count, individual term replacements, and search volume are attributes of one research artifact; blog-specific keyword usage is independently controlled under REQ_BLOG_KEYWORD_TARGETING.

requirements.title: Blog Article Delivery
requirements.definition: Create the agreed number of SEO blog articles and provide their content for client review.
requirements.boundary_note: Article quantity and drafting belong to one delivery mechanism; topic selection, keyword targeting, images, links, content specifications, and publication have separate acceptance criteria.

requirements.title: Blog Topic Selection
requirements.definition: Propose, revise, document, and obtain approval for the topics or themes used by the SEO blogs.
requirements.boundary_note: Topic or theme choice can be revised independently of article quantity, keyword choice, and publication status.

requirements.title: Blog Keyword Targeting
requirements.definition: Use the client-approved keyword set when planning and writing blog content.
requirements.boundary_note: This covers keyword use within blogs, not preparation of the broader campaign keyword-research sheet.

requirements.title: Blog Content Specifications
requirements.definition: Ensure each affected blog follows its client-defined content constraints, including intended audience and requested article length.
requirements.boundary_note: Audience and word-count constraints are attributes of article content quality; images and internal links are separately testable inclusions.

requirements.title: Blog Images
requirements.definition: Include relevant images with each applicable blog article in the quantity and placement requested by the client.
requirements.boundary_note: Image presence, relevance, count, and placement can be changed or verified independently from article text and internal linking.

requirements.title: Blog Internal Linking
requirements.definition: Embed relevant internal links in blog articles, including links to products and related site content.
requirements.boundary_note: Internal links have their own destinations and acceptance criterion and can be modified independently from images or article text.

requirements.title: Blog Review and Publication
requirements.definition: Publish blog articles to the website only after the required client review and approval conditions are satisfied.
requirements.boundary_note: Publication and its approval gate can succeed or fail independently from drafting the article and satisfying its content attributes.

requirements.title: Backlink Campaign
requirements.definition: Create the agreed backlink set with the specified campaign quantity and dofollow-to-nofollow composition.
requirements.boundary_note: Backlink count and link-type ratio are attributes of one campaign; search-engine indexing of created links is a separate behavior.

requirements.title: Backlink Indexing
requirements.definition: Submit campaign backlinks for indexing, report their indexed status, and re-submit unindexed links as requested.
requirements.boundary_note: Index submission and discoverability have a distinct failure and remediation trajectory from initial backlink creation.

requirements.title: Meta Title and Description Optimization
requirements.definition: Optimize website meta titles and meta descriptions as part of the approved on-page SEO work.
requirements.boundary_note: Metadata optimization is independently reviewable from headings, image ALT attributes, sitemap behavior, and the requested comparison document.

requirements.title: Heading Structure Optimization
requirements.definition: Correct improper page-heading structure, including inappropriate multiple-H1 usage, as part of on-page SEO.
requirements.boundary_note: Heading structure has an independent completion criterion and should not be merged into a broad on-page SEO umbrella.

requirements.title: Image ALT Text Optimization
requirements.definition: Add or correct ALT attributes for website images as part of on-page SEO.
requirements.boundary_note: Website ALT attributes are independently implementable and verifiable from blog-image quantity and other on-page tasks.

requirements.title: Sitemap Configuration
requirements.definition: Correct sitemap errors and maintain a sitemap that can be successfully submitted and processed by Google Search Console.
requirements.boundary_note: Sitemap error correction and processing have a distinct implementation and runtime-verification trajectory from metadata, headings, and image ALT work.

requirements.title: Webpage Content Optimization
requirements.definition: Apply the approved SEO revisions to general website page content.
requirements.boundary_note: General webpage-content revisions are separate from blog-topic revisions and the specifically identified Campus Launch sale page.

requirements.title: Campus Launch Sale Page Optimization
requirements.definition: Apply the specified SEO and content changes to the Campus Launch sale landing page.
requirements.boundary_note: This page has its own editing path, permission issue, suggested-change artifact, and implementation trajectory, so it remains separate from general webpage content.

requirements.title: Metadata Before-and-After Report
requirements.definition: Provide a document listing the before-and-after values for updated meta titles and meta descriptions.
requirements.boundary_note: The comparison document remains independently required even if the underlying metadata changes have already been implemented.

unresolved_candidates.description: The accepted trial scope clearly retains blogs, on-page SEO, and backlinks, but the evidence does not safely establish whether guest posting was explicitly removed or merely omitted from the trial.

The approved on-page reports and attachments may contain additional independently testable tasks not named in the supplied messages; the visible evidence safely identifies metadata, headings, image ALT text, sitemap, and content updates only.

The exchange shifts from a revised blog theme to webpage content. The final approval identifies webpage content, but unavailable attachment context may affect whether an additional specific page-content Requirement is needed.
The client proposes adding six more blogs, but the supplied history contains no clear acceptance or rejection of that scope increase.
Re-indexing the 164 unindexed links is explicit, but the requested policy for replacing links that remain unindexed is unanswered and cannot yet be treated as a confirmed replacement obligation.
